title: Data Protocol
description: DESIGN-stage artifact. Output of data-protocol-designer. Declares preprocessing, augmentation, and postprocessing steps for all conditions. Anti-leakage rule (structurally enforced via allOf): any step with kind='augmentation' MUST have train_only:true — augmentation applied to test data is a leakage bug and is schema-rejected. Protocols with no augmentation steps at all are valid (the per-item rule only fires when an augmentation step is present).

from_split_manifest_ref.description: Reference to the split_manifest this protocol is designed for

steps.description: Ordered list of data processing steps

train_only.description: True = applied only to training data; False = applied to all splits. Augmentation steps MUST be true.

applies_to_splits.description: Explicit split names this step applies to (empty = inferred from train_only)

allOf.description: Anti-leakage: any step with kind='augmentation' must have train_only:true. A protocol with no augmentation steps is valid; a protocol where any augmentation step has train_only:false is REJECTED.
